briefing.headline: xAI and OpenAI escalate model race with simultaneous frontier releases amid record funding

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs shipping advanced reasoning models this week. Funding remains robust while geopolitical tensions over chip export controls continue. Safety concerns mount as deployment outpaces mitigation strategies.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-3 achieving new SOTA on GPQA while OpenAI deployed o4-preview with enhanced agentic capabilities. DeepSeek-V4 and Meta's Llama-4 derivatives also launched, narrowing the gap with Western labs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with early automotive and IoT pilots showing strong results against adversarial attacks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced a new 200k H100 cluster in Texas while TSMC reported record AI chip demand. Google expanded its TPU v6 fleet by 40% to support Gemini training.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation between US, EU, and China slow frontier model progress more than technical bottlenecks by 2028?
